name: The Goblin Messenger's Cipher
description:
## Lore

A goblin spy was intercepted at the border of the Whispering Marshes, carrying a sealed parchment meant for the Dark Council. The message is encrypted in a cipher known only to the goblin clans — a polyalphabetic substitution passed down through generations of their war-scribes.

Intelligence reports suggest the fortress of Karzul guards its secrets well, and the goblins have long used names of power as keys to their ciphers.

## Your Task

Decrypt the intercepted message to recover the hidden flag.

## Flag Format

The flag is in the format: `FantasyCTF{...}`

hints.content: The goblin king always named his tools after his home.
Try the fortress name as the cipher key.
